name: Registrum API
description:
# Registrum API

UK company intelligence - structured financials, director networks, and intelligent caching - from a single developer-friendly REST API.

---

## Quick Start

### 1. Get your API key

Sign up to receive your API key.

### 2. Authenticate your requests

Include your API key in the **`X-API-Key`** header with every request:

```
X-API-Key: reg_live_your_key_here
```

> **Using the interactive docs below?** Click the green **Authorize** button at the top of this page, paste your API key, and click **Authorize**. All subsequent "Try it out" requests will include it automatically.

### 3. Make your first request

Search for a company:
```
GET /v1/search?q=tesco
```

Get an enriched company profile:
```
GET /v1/company/00445790
```

### Client libraries & examples

- **Python**: [companies-house-api-python-starter](https://github.com/RegistrumUK/companies-house-api-python-starter) - auth, rate-limit backoff, pagination, and the iXBRL-vs-PDF gotcha, in one file
- **Node.js**: [companies-house-api-node-starter](https://github.com/RegistrumUK/companies-house-api-node-starter) - same, using the built-in `fetch`
- **MCP (Claude, Cursor)**: [registrum-mcp](https://github.com/vdmeu/registrum-mcp) server, with a [prompt cookbook and example scripts](https://github.com/RegistrumUK/registrum-mcp-examples)

---

## How It Works

This API sits on top of the [Companies House public API](https://developer.company-information.service.gov.uk/) and adds:

- **Intelligent caching** - responses are cached so repeat queries are instant and you never hit rate limits
- **Enriched profiles** - company age, accounts status, size classification, and more in a single call
- **Director networks** - discover all companies connected through shared directors
- **Structured financials** - parsed iXBRL filings returned as clean JSON with current + prior year

## Upstream Call Costs & Throughput

Each endpoint makes a different number of calls to the Companies House API on your behalf.
**Cached responses cost nothing** - once a company is fetched, repeat requests within the cache window are instant.

| Endpoint | Upstream calls (cold cache) | Cache duration |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /v1/search` | 1 per unique query | 1 hour |
| `GET /v1/company/{n}` | 1 per company | 30 days |
| `GET /v1/company/{n}/directors` | ~N+2 (N = number of directors) | 30 days |
| `GET /v1/company/{n}/network?depth=1` | ~N+2 | 30 days |
| `GET /v1/company/{n}/network?depth=2` | 50–200 (capped at 30 connected companies) | 30 days |
| `GET /v1/company/{n}/financials` | 2–3 (filing history + doc metadata + iXBRL download) | 90 days |
| `GET /v1/health` | 0 | - |
| `GET /v1/health/deep` | 1 | - |
| `GET /v1/health/probes` | 0 | - |

**Safe throughput on cold cache (approximate, across all customers):**
- Search and company profiles: up to ~100 unique queries per minute
- Directors and network (depth=1): up to ~8 different companies per minute
- Network (depth=2): up to ~2–3 different companies per 5 minutes

If these rates are exceeded, responses slow briefly (typically 5–15 seconds) while upstream capacity
recovers - you won't receive errors, just slightly higher latency. The cache eliminates this concern
for any company queried more than once within the cache window.

## Response Format

Every endpoint returns responses in this standard format:

```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "data": { ... },
  "cached": true,
  "cache_age_seconds": 3421,
  "credits_used": 1,
  "credits_remaining": 487
}
```

## Response Headers

Every response includes:
- `X-Request-Id` - unique ID for this request (useful for debugging/support)
- `X-API-Version` - current API version
- `X-Data-Stale: true` - only present when serving expired cache during an upstream outage

## Rate Limits

Every new key gets full access for its first 60 days - no monthly quota, every endpoint - then moves to Free. Live values: `GET /v1/plans`.

| Tier | Price | Calls/month | Calls/day | Burst |
|------|-------|-------------|-----------|-------|
| Free | Free | 50 | 15 | 10/min |
| Web | £9/mo | 500 | 50 | 30/min |
| Pro | £49/mo | 4,000 | 400 | 100/min |
| Enterprise | On request | Unlimited | Unlimited | 150/min |

**Pro/Enterprise-only features:** `network?depth=2`, PSC chain traversal, and ECCTA compliance monitoring.
Free/Web requests to these return `403 PLAN_REQUIRED` with an `upgrade_url`.

## Errors

Errors return a JSON object with `status: "error"` and a human-readable `detail` message:

```json
{
  "status": "error",
  "detail": "Company 99999999 not found",
  "request_id": "a1b2c3d4-..."
}
```

| Status Code | Meaning |
|-------------|---------|
| 400 | Invalid input (e.g., bad company number format) |
| 401 | Missing or invalid API key |
| 404 | Company not found |
| 422 | Validation error (e.g., search query too long) |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded |
| 502 | Companies House API is temporarily unavailable |
| 500 | Unexpected server error |

## Usage Dashboard

Track your API calls, quota, and reset date at **[registrum.co.uk/dashboard](https://registrum.co.uk/dashboard)**.
Sign in with the email you used to get your key - no password needed.

Or call `GET /v1/usage` (free, no credit consumed) to read quota programmatically.

## Need Help?

Include the `X-Request-Id` from your response headers when contacting support - it helps us trace exactly what happened.
